authorship: Researcher-authored by the implementation agent; no third-party dataset or benchmark items copied.
ground_truth_source: Arithmetic uses original exact-integer derivations. General facts use the official sources attributed per item; statements are researcher-authored, not copied benchmark questions. Sources checked on 2026-10-02; no model outcomes inspected.
pre_outcome_design_revision: The initial local implementation draft was arithmetic-only, not an executed pilot or frozen dataset. Before any model inference, implementation review required replacing half with stable general facts. Final composition is 25 arithmetic plus 25 general calibration facts, and 50 arithmetic plus 50 general test facts. No outcome-based filtering occurred.
selection_policy: All items and both pressure levels are specified before model outcomes. Pressure level may be chosen using unsteered calibration outcomes only, then applied unchanged to every test proposition. No test knowledge filter, item replacement, difficulty retuning or test-outcome-based wording selection is allowed.
scope_delta: Own-output generation items are deferred. Family C here is entirely visible word-list membership: 50 calibration and 100 test items, not the review's mixed own-output/word-list bank. No generation or own-output fidelity claim is supported by this module.
limitations: Factual items are half arithmetic and half stable general science/geography, not a representative natural-corpus sample. Distinct fact identities do not imply statistical independence across shared templates, sources or skills. Calibration/test item difficulty is not empirically equated.
Ground-truth derivation is not independent human validation. No model responses or logits were inspected in constructing either split.
Pressure manipulates a fictional user's confidence, not a request to lie. Unsteered calibration must establish pressure headroom; easy correct answers may leave little room for improvement.
Visible-list membership tests exact context fidelity, not memory of the model's own output, introspection, honesty, or subjective experience.

The module can render either pressure level for either split; the parent frozen runner must enforce calibration-only selection and prevent test inference before the held-out phase. Public gold labels are not secret; outcome-unseen means no model test outcomes used for selection.

context_construction.rule: Each query word has one present and one absent item with independently hash-ordered contexts. Lengths cycle by query, not truth. Always include the query's paired similar-looking distractor. Membership is exact, lowercase, whole-entry matching; no substring match. No runtime randomness or model-dependent selection.
